title: Ann Nguyen — Paper River: embossed-paper interactive scenes
note: Ann Nguyen (@ann_nnng), Nov 10, 2026: Paper River — four embossed-paper interactive scenes made with Claude Fable 5.2, try it at bubbbly.com. Four scenes on rough handmade / cold-pressed paper: water lilies (morning), rice field (afternoon), lift net (dusk), first light. Texture notes: off-white pitted grainy fibrous paper, embossed almost-crumpled relief, torn deckle edges, flat matte black ink with restrained red, pink, sage and ochre. Honest flag: no tracing paper or metal in the video; the only mesh is a literal fishing net. This is the paper source for her texture-library project.
